detail.longDescription: Google Forms and SurveyMonkey are leaders in their category for different reasons: one is a simple form tool that nearly everyone already has free access to, and the other has been the poster child for survey creation for over two decades. SurveyMonkey, despite its cuddly name, has evolved into a distinctly corporate tool focused on things like market research, Net Promoter Score surveys, and brand health tracking. Google Forms, meanwhile, is hugely popular for sending out free forms and surveys
